summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#625](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/625)** — Detector constructors now set the sensitive-detector type (`calorimeter` or `tracker`) themselves, and all `<sensitive type="..."/>` tags are removed from the compact XML files, including ALLEGRO, IDEA, CLD and FCChh. As a result, the FCChh tail catcher now produces tracker hits instead of calorimeter hits. The archived FCCDetectors drivers used by `FCCee_o2_v03` need the same update before they can load these compacts.

- **[key4hep/CLDConfig#98](https://github.com/key4hep/CLDConfig/pull/98)** — The `CONFIG` dictionary in `CLDReconstruction.py` is replaced by command-line arguments: `--calorimeterIntegrationTimeWindow`, `--overlay` (with a new `Skip` option), `--vertexUnconstrained` and `--outputMode`. `--native` combined with LCIO output is now rejected. `BEAM_SPOT_SIZES` are updated to the luminous-region sizes from the 2025 FCC Feasibility Study Report, which changes results, so samples produced before and after this change should be distinguished.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#534](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/534)** — Adds `MutableSimCalorimeterHit::addMCParticleContribution`, which attaches a `CaloHitContribution` and adds its energy to the hit in one call. This prevents hit energies from drifting away from the sum of their contributions, for example when merging hits during overlay. The docs now state that `SimCalorimeterHit` energy is the sum of its contributions with no time selection, so time windows must be handled in digitization.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/109)** — Adds an initial ACTS Adaptive Multi-Vertex Finder for primary-vertex reconstruction from existing EDM4hep tracks. It supports configurable track selection, beam-spot constraint, seeding and annealing, and stores weighted vertex–particle links. Includes a CLD setup tuned for FCC-ee beam conditions, validated against LCFIPlus.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#137](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/137)** — `CKFTrackingAlg` now takes each hit's time resolution from the EDM4hep 1.2 hit time error, for both 4D CKF measurements and seeding time cuts. `HitTimeResolutions` remains as a fallback for older files, and a hit with neither now throws.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#74](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/74)** — `DDPlanarDigi` stores the per-layer digitization time resolution as the tracker-hit time error introduced in EDM4hep 1.2. Without time smearing the error stays 0; downstream tracking uses this value.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#75](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/75)** — Fixes a crash in `GaudiTrkUtils` (ConformalTracking) for trackers with a detector ID above 20, such as the ALLEGRO and IDEA silicon wrappers. The crash came from an LCIO/ILC-era assumption that no longer holds for these detectors.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1703](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1703)** — Adds a placement-path cache so all child paths of a DetElement are found in a single walk of its volume tree. With the cache, the SurfaceManager's first map build for ALLEGRO_o1_v04 drops from about 350 s to 1.8 s. This removes most of the initialization time previously charged to the first `DDPlanarDigi`.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#114](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/114)** — Matching tracker hits to MC particles in `TracksFromGenParticles` now pre-builds a particle-to-hits map instead of scanning every hit for every particle. This makes the algorithm about 80× faster in ALLEGRO ZH digi/reco.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#51](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/51)** — `DDPandoraPFANewAlgorithm` gains 2D theta–energy corrections for the electromagnetic and hadronic branches, each loaded from a JSON table written by the calibration scripts. Tables are validated at `initialize()`; with no file given, the corrections are the identity, so existing configurations are unchanged. The package now depends on nlohmann json.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#410](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/410)** — The ALLEGRO o1_v03 and o2_v01 recipes now pass the ddsim steering file. Without it, gaseous-tracker hits below 1 keV are discarded and some hits are merged, which breaks drift-chamber digitization.

- **[key4hep/k4Opt#32](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Opt/pull/32)** — Introduces `k4opt optimize`, which runs detector-optimization studies of a problem with Optuna's TPE sampler. Studies are resumable and write one run record per trial; Optuna is confined to a single adapter, so problem files and evaluators remain optimizer-independent.
